# shadcn CSS

Unmodified `dist/tailwind.css` from the MIT-licensed npm package `shadcn@4.21.0`.

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/main/packages/shadcn

SHA-256: `bc7d83425702955b4cb67cb14ede9d603f9d912376d57a2d81d661094d2a782a`

The application needs these static Tailwind variants, not the component-generation CLI. Keeping the CSS and license here removes the CLI dependency chain affected by [GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm). Update this file with its source version and digest whenever updating the CSS.
